changes.value: Canonical plurality, Synoptic dependence, Mark and John's contrasting arrest portraits, parabolic readings of loaves and Emmaus, and retrospective prophecy together support developing theological interpretation without requiring uniformly literal history.

Therefore, the Gospels can remain religiously authentic as community-shaped versions: dependent Synoptic streams, divergent passion portraits, meaning-bearing narratives, and retrospectively applied hopes limit claims of uniform historical reporting.
